definition: The European Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (EUROAI), also referred to as the Central European Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (CEOAI), is a regional science olympiad in artificial intelligence for secondary school students, organized by the Nitro Association.
details: Its first edition was hosted in July 2026 by Babeș-Bolyai University in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, in partnership with the Cluj County School Inspectorate and Romania's Ministry of Education and Research. Each accredited country selects a national team of up to four students, accompanied by a team leader, a deputy leader and any number of observers, through its own national AI competition or selection process. The competition itself is an individual competition held over two contest days, testing both theoretical understanding and practical machine learning ability; students are required to train their own models rather than use pre-trained or off-the-shelf systems.
